title: Multi-Domain Job Orchestration
brief: Routes a single manufacturing job across PRISM domain pipelines (mill / lathe / wedm / sinker / grinder / laser / waterjet) when the part needs features no single domain can produce alone. Examples: shaft with turned OD + milled flats; die plate with milled pocket + EDM corner; tool insert with ground OD + EDM punch. Produces the cross-domain plan (which features → which domain, in what order, with what handoff cost) — does NOT execute the per-domain pipelines (those live in LathePrintToProgram + MillingAGIMaster + WireEDMAGIOrchestrator).

close_out_log.note: CrossDomainOrchestratorEngine + FEATURE_DOMAIN_MAP (38 feature types → 9 domains) + handoff cost matrix (mill↔mill_turn=60s, lathe↔mill=600s, EDM/grinder handoffs=1200-1800s) + 3 dispatcher actions (orch_multidomain_plan / orch_multidomain_summarize / orch_multidomain_feature_map) wired into intelligenceDispatcher.ts. 27 tests including 3 happy-path JM Die fixtures (shaft+flats, die plate, tool insert), 5 domain-resolution paths (operator pin / preferred bias / unknown / all-unknown placeholder), 6 handoff invariants, 4 estimate paths, 5 schema/invariant guards, 3 dispatcher wiring assertions.

units.title: CrossDomainOrchestratorEngine + dispatcher wiring + tests
exit_conditions: planJob() returns segments[] grouped by consecutive same-domain features with handoff costs
preferred_domains[] biases ambiguous features (chamfer_od → mill_turn vs lathe)
Unknown feature types surface in unresolved_features[] with reason
All-unknown features produce a placeholder segment + warning (never an empty plan)
3 dispatcher actions in intelligenceDispatcher ACTIONS enum + cases
Tests: 27 cases covering routing, handoff, estimate, invariants, dispatcher integration
units.description: Cross-domain planner — the missing 'Layer 3 enrichment' piece for jobs with mixed-domain features. Pure engine (no I/O, no MCP imports). Consensus is an optional caller seam following the LATHE-P2P-CONSENSUS-MS4 pattern; this MS ships the deterministic plan and leaves consensus integration to MS12+.

acceptance: Single-engine orchestrator + 3 dispatcher actions + 27 tests passing. Covers 3 representative multi-domain fixtures: lathe→mill shaft, mill→wedm die plate, grinder→wedm tool insert.

risks.description: Handoff cost matrix is shop-floor-average — production shops should override per their actual fixture/inspection times via PrismCustomerProfile.

FEATURE_DOMAIN_MAP is surface-level — does NOT consult per-domain capability registries at runtime; drift between this map and (e.g.) MillFeatureRecognition will produce wrong routing. Mitigated by tests asserting disjoint canonical features (od_turn ∉ mill, pocket ∉ lathe).
